## Research question

Is recent whole-grain consumption associated with within-person variation in gut microbial profiles in HMP2?

## Data preparation

The descriptive reference below uses collections with complete microbial and metabolomic profiles and recorded dietary and antibiotic responses. The primary analysis population will be specified separately.

```{r, echo=FALSE}
counts_path <- "../results/tables/reference_counts.csv"
if (file.exists(counts_path)) {
  summary <- read.csv(counts_path)
  summary$metric <- gsub("_", " ", summary$metric, fixed = TRUE)
  knitr::kable(summary, col.names = c("Metric", "Count"))
} else {
  cat("Run R/build_reference.R from the project root to generate the cohort counts.")
}
```

## Analysis

The statistical analysis and interpretation will be added after cohort qualification.
